CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

5. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

6. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

7. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

8. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

9. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.

10. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   C. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

   B. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.

12. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain String Musical Instruments and Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
